ns2:course.label: Seminar Philosophy of Science
ns2:course.description: Various problems arising from specific studies in philosophy pertaining to science and vice versa. To be offered with varying topics. Approved for letter and S/U grading. May be repeated. Letter grading applies when offered for 4 hours of credit. For Stage 3 Philosophy PhD students this course is approved for S/U grading when offered for 2 hours of credit. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor for non-philosophy graduate students.
